## Aug 31st: Arrival

Luckily, my skill to dribble jet lag when flying to the US is strong and I was able to sleep through my first night after arriving in Ithaca on Sunday.
I was greeted by different members of the Human Ecology Lab at Cornell and everyone was just lovely.
Allison gave me a tour through the Martha Van Rensselaer building, impressing me with how knowledgeable she is about this university. 

This afternoon I will introduce myself and my work to the lab and also a class of students, which I'm very excited about.
Hopefully, the tiredness-crash will happen later in the evening!
